The weekly 95% stop, hold rules, account binding, token renewal and concurrency 3 were unchanged; the change affected scheduling only, not the plan, bench, harness or evaluator (controller sha256 a331443b to 164311f7).
The full view is kept as a draft release, as for primary181 since 2026-10-31; the website serves a slim projection.

Scoring change (owner decision, 2026-11-04): the website shows one score per agent and task, the pair score versus COBYQA (definition cobyqa-pair-score/1). Each agent is compared with COBYQA alone in a two-member OptiProfiler 1.3.4 comparison; the score is (1 + s_agent - s_COBYQA) / 2, where s is the history-based performance-profile area normalized per tolerance and averaged over the 10 tolerances 1e-1 to 1e-10, so 0.5 means level with COBYQA. A pair score depends only on the histories of the agent and COBYQA. It replaces the joint comparison score and its p^4 display transform on the website.

Histories, usage, prices and the 183 scored groups are those of primary183 (web-primary183-fable-randomnan-20261104); its joint comparison scores and profiles stay in this full view unchanged. New are data/pair/ (pair scores, display curves at 4 tolerances and log-ratio profiles for every agent of the full view), the results.json field pair_scores with the definition and file checksums, and a check.mjs that validates them. The pair data were computed on macOS arm64 with OptiProfiler 1.3.4 and numpy 2.5.3; all 732 log-ratio profiles equal those of OptiProfiler.

Rank changes per task against the primary183 joint ranking of the 43 displayed agents: Spearman 0.982 (Perturbed), 0.950 (Noisy), 0.980 (Rotated), 0.964 (RandomNaN); 9 of the top 10 stay in the top 10 on every task; rank 1 is unchanged except on Perturbed, where GPT-6 Astra high and GPT-6.1 Sol high swap (both 0.694).
The full view is kept as a draft release, as for primary181 to primary183; the website serves a slim projection.
